papers.title: Semi-Implicit Graph Variational Auto-Encoders
papers.verified_operation: Noise at multiple GNN layers plus neighboring-node distribution sharing yields a semi-implicit graph latent posterior; Eq.7 is a conditionally factorial Bernoulli-Poisson decoder and Eq.8 an ELBO.
papers.closest_role: Shared stochastic graph-latent single ancestry; marginalizing graph latents can induce dependencies despite conditional factorial decoding.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Link-ranking readout and sample averaging unresolved in this scope; no same-context native residual adapter or calibrated missing-link posterior qualified.

papers.title: SeeGera: Self-supervised Semi-implicit Graph Variational Auto-encoders with Masking
papers.verified_operation: Semi-implicit node/feature embeddings, correlated mixing (Eq.10), a Bernoulli edge decoder, structure/feature masking layer (Eq.18), and importance-weighted surrogate (Eq.19).
papers.closest_role: Masking with richer shared graph latents is an established structured-single alternative.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Feature reconstruction and feature-embedding information/objective budgets differ; source/readout qualification and native residual adaptation remain missing.

papers.title: Graphite: Iterative Generative Modeling of Graphs
papers.verified_operation: A VAE graph law uses latent-derived adjacency and iterative reverse GNN message passing before a conditionally factorial edge decoder (Eqs.8–10).
papers.closest_role: Iterative learned graph refinement and latent structured-single ancestry.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Integrated latent law must be distinguished from edge-independent fixed readout. Source/readout qualification and official Collab comparison remain missing.

papers.title: On the Role of Edge Dependency in Graph Generative Models
papers.verified_operation: Dependency hierarchy distinguishes fixed edge-independent laws, independent node latents and fully dependent laws; triangle/cycle theorem statements and correlated maximal-clique planting are inspected.
papers.closest_role: Identity-aware motifs and graph overlap give graph-specific coherence ancestry beyond member disagreement.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Proofs not audited; no NCNC J/F auxiliary or target-ranker implementation qualified. Casual Graphite labeling cannot erase dependence from its integrated latent law.

papers.title: Prior-Informed Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction
papers.verified_operation: Sigmoid NCNC is an informed edge prior (§4.1; depth-one IncompleteCN1Predictor in B.4); Eq.7 initializes masked adjacency and graph-conditioned flow learns coupled refinement. MSE and v2 masked weighted CE are declared; Cora E.8 uses edge-centered subgraphs and logit stitching.
papers.closest_role: Direct missing comparator for NCNC plus learned joint graph refinement and correlated 00/11 motivation; generic coherent-configuration novelty is blocked.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Complete frozen four-component native-residual J/F composition is not established equal. Public snapshot predates paper versions, has no qualified native NCNC/weighted-CE route, and requires TRAIN-only interpolant ownership plus authentic candidate/context coverage for a HeaRT adaptation.

papers.title: Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion
papers.verified_operation: TRAIN observed/target fact partitions, arbitrary categorical component masks, contextual message passing and an any-order autoregressive/masked-discrete-diffusion NLL (Eq.7); one-pass single-mask LP and iterative multi-mask completion.
papers.closest_role: Capable shared full-context higher-order single; per-component CE under changing revealed context is not the fixed-context F marginal law.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Hyper-relational categorical support and candidate vocabularies differ from native residual Bernoulli slots. No author-code, binary residual adapter or official Collab qualification.

papers.title: Autoregressive Models for Knowledge Graph Generation
papers.verified_operation: Teacher-forced chain-rule autoregressive triple-sequence CE; SAIL adds shared graph latent conditioning and an ELBO, with partial-graph completion and beam/sampling readouts.
papers.closest_role: Higher-order autoregressive and shared-latent structured-single alternatives.
papers.qualification_and_difference_boundary: Random ordering is not exact permutation-invariance proof. EOS/top-k/top-p/max-length readout is not full-support residual likelihood or authentic LP candidate ranking; no author-source qualification.

joint_bank_analytic_boundaries: For disjoint residual groups and fixed context, dependence through a four-state component gives conditional mutual information at most log(4).
Between-component covariance rank is at most three; conditional Bernoulli variance contributes the diagonal.
Rooted four-clique closure expectation differs between J mixture-of-products and F product-of-mixture-marginals; no occurrence, usefulness or exact decoder-realization evidence is claimed.
overall_boundary: Implementation differences and bounded absent-token searches do not prove novelty. No experiment, implementation release, method adoption or manuscript-positive verdict is issued.
